about: How each open position's shortlist is scored (0-100). Weights should add up to 1. popularity: how much pros play the hero in that position (recent games count more; the focus team's games count focusWeight times, set in meta-config.json). winRate: the hero's pro win rate there, smoothed so small samples stay near 50%. counter: how the hero's team did in pro games against the heroes the enemy has picked now. synergy: how it did alongside our current picks. focusTieBreak: at most this much extra (0-1 scale) for the focus team's own record, so it only breaks near-ties.
